parameters.name: ResourceId
parameters.description: The ID of the SMC resource. SMC resources include migration sources and migration tasks. You can specify 1 to 50 resource IDs.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description:
The type of the SMC resource. Valid values:

- sourceserver: migration source

- replicationjob: migration task

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description:
The key of tag N to add to the SMC resource. Valid values of N: 1 to 20.

The tag key cannot be an empty string. The key can be up to 64 characters in length. It cannot start with aliyun or acs:. It also cannot contain http\:// or https\://.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description:
The value of tag N to add to the SMC resource. Valid values of N: 1 to 20.

The tag value can be an empty string. The value can be up to 64 characters in length and cannot contain http\:// or https\://.
